howToRefresh: Edit this file when Ratehub.ca (or a bank's own rate page) shows new illustrative rates. Keep updated as an ISO-8601 datetime and updatedLabel as the words that should appear after 'Rates as of'. The explorer reads this file in the browser, so the interactive numbers update without a redesign. Then run: cd _build && python3 build.py — that refreshes the no-JavaScript table, the schema date, and the sitemap lastmod. Keep banks in this fixed order. Do not rank them, and do not describe a rate as preferable to another.
checkedAgainst: Live Ratehub.ca Big 5 comparison table and Ratehub.ca 1-year fixed table, both stamped October 28, 2026, 9:14 p.m. An earlier Ratehub stamp the same day (about 3:02 p.m.) showed different 5-year variable rates and different Scotiabank fixed rates. This file follows the later stamp.

source.name: Ratehub.ca
source.note: Illustrative rates as published by Ratehub.ca. The Big 5 comparison table is not labeled there as a posted rate or as a special offer. The 1-year figures are the rates Ratehub lists beside each bank on its 1-year fixed table (not the open-rate table, and not the unnamed row). They can change, and they may not match a rate a client is offered.
